results.title: Stardom 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Sapporo ~ Day 1
results.original_title: 第15回 ゴッデス・オブ・スターダム ～タッグリーグ戦～ in SAPPORO Day1
results.overview: 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Sapporo ~ Day 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It took place on November 15, 2025, at Chateraise Gateaux Kingdom Sapporo in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, and served as the 6th show of the tournament's tour.

results.title: Bif Naked
results.overview: BIF NAKED is a raw and electrifying look at one of Canada’s most iconic and fearless artists. Born in India, adopted by American missionaries, and raised in Winnipeg, Bif carved her own path—rising through the male-dominated punk scene with her unmistakable voice, poetic lyrics, and defiant spirit.  Behind the tattoos and powerhouse performances is a survivor of cancer, addiction, and heartbreak, whose strength and vulnerability reshaped what it means to be a rock star. Through rare footage, intimate interviews, and unforgettable performances, this documentary celebrates a woman who’s never played by the rules—and never backed down.

results.title: Bots
results.overview: A unit of dedicated bots scheme chaos and divisiveness from their office desks in Rich Williamson’s wickedly humorous and sharp satirical take on the absurd amount of power relinquished to the unhinged forces steering world politics.

results.title: Breakups Suck
results.overview: Luca fears for his life while preparing to dump his girlfriend Ruby, who may or may not be a vampire. He quickly realizes, leaving her may not be as easy as he thought...

results.title: Wedding Registry
results.overview: Nicolás and Antonia plan a fake wedding to share the gifts and fund their dreams.

results.title: Ambush
results.overview: In this short, a pop-up techno club ambushes the streets of downtown Amman flooding a conservative neighborhood with heavy bass and unfamiliar faces.

results.title: New Life
results.overview: The girl Zhao Xiaoman repeated her life of doing odd jobs, and the intrusion of a stray dog gradually made her let go of the pain of her family. The inseparable day and night companionship warmed the two lonely souls. When bidding farewell is inevitable, should we still take care of it? Xiaoman chose to respond calmly with actions - I want to take care of myself, we will all be fine.

results.title: Объяснительная записка
results.overview: Valya persuades her classmate Sonya to skip classes and go swimming in the river, where there is sun and freedom. She timidly agrees and, in order to justify herself in the eyes of the class teacher, writes her an explanatory note. But the love that Sonya dreamed of does not happen: having received the desired kiss, Valya loses interest in her. She could have kept silent, endured, but Sonya assesses the situation - yes, life does not always match dreams - and leaves in time. She returns to the class teacher with a guilty conscience, flushes the explanatory note down the toilet. It seems that this is a failure. But in the final scene she still smiles: this experience was not in vain. Everything will still be.

results.title: Leelo: We’ll Laugh in the End, No Matter What
results.overview: The documentary unveils the hidden and colorful facets of beloved Estonian writer Leelo Tungal, taking the viewer on a journey through her life, her family and national values—all shaped by the shifting winds of social and political change across decades. How is it possible to create something bigger than oneself and bring together generations on book pages, Eurovision stage and also under the arch of the Song Festival Grounds?

results.title: Aai Saiba!
results.overview: When kind-hearted but clumsy Tiatr dreamer Joe finally gets his big break at the 100th show, a kidnapping gone wrong plunges him into comic chaos forcing him to save the performance and his only chance to shine.

results.title: Crusts
results.overview: A coming-of-age story about the first time you act against your true nature. Inspired by the old wives tale - eating the bread crusts makes your hair go curly - Paris explores and her relationship with her crusts, her best friend, and her hair.

results.title: Halfway Haunted
results.overview: A tenant in a haunted house reluctantly teams up with a ghost to stop a real estate developer from demolishing the home they share.

results.title: The Audition
results.overview: An actress prepares to audition for a big movie tonight, but first needs to learn several special skills, quick.

results.title: Ni-Naadamaadiz: Red Power Rising
results.overview: Despite it lasting 90 days in 1974, there is only eight minutes of footage about an Indigenous youth-led armed occupation in Kenora, Ontario. The documentary Ni-Naadamaadiz: Red Power Rising tells that story of Indigenous resilience and power.

results.title: Ultimate Mission
results.overview: A deadly virus erupts on Pacific's Asel Island. Facing armed biohazards, an international bio-safety team deploys 3 agents for a time-sensitive rescue mission.

results.title: Somewhere Together
results.overview: Two best friends learning to balance school with life and realizing they always have each other.

results.title: A Wolf Among the Swans
results.overview: Thiago Soares is a young man from the suburbs of Rio de Janeiro who leaves hip hop behind and embarks on the world of classical ballet. His story takes on unexpected turns through his troubled relationship with his mentor, the Cuban Dino Carrera, who improves Thiago's talent until he reaches stardom by becoming the principal dancer of the Royal Ballet in London.

results.title: Merry Little Mystery
results.overview: Natasha Maxwell spends the holidays at her grandparent’s house in the tiny town of Roundtop, where she grew up. She happily takes over from her grandfather as the small town’s benevolent Secret Santa, covertly delivering gifts to deserving and grateful citizens. Meanwhile, while attempting to foil Adrian, an investigative reporter determined to reveal Natasha’s identity as the mystery gift giver, she ends up falling in love.

results.title: Demir Hisar - My Macedonian Film Workshop
results.overview: A seriously entertaining hybrid feature that questions what is 'real' in a story that begins like a documentary about Filmmaking as Therapy, for psychiatric patients, and ends like a fairytale, testing viewers' perception throughout.
